notes.title: Keybind Changes + Free Demo!
notes.notes:
[h2]⚙️ Keybinds Changes[/h2]

We’ve made an important change to how zoom keybinds work in Scope X.  
From now on, [b]Increase Zoom[/b], [b]Decrease Zoom[/b], and [b]Set Zoom[/b] actions will only function when the [b]Zoom Overlay[/b] is already active.  

This means:  
[*] Toggling the overlay on (via your overlay keybind or the UI) comes first.  
[*] Once active, [b]Increase/Decrease Zoom[/b] lets you smoothly adjust zoom levels.  
[*] [b]Set Zoom[/b] instantly jumps to your chosen zoom level while the overlay is active.  

This ensures clearer, more predictable behavior for zoom keybinds.

[h2]🆓 Try Scope X for Free[/h2]

Scope X now has a [b]Demo[/b]!  
You can try Scope X before purchasing the full version. Some features are restricted, but you’ll still get a feel for how zoom, and keybinds work with limited access.  

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3920360/Scope_X/

[h2]🌿 Small Updates[/h2]  
[*] "Launch on startup " will match your system preference.  
[*] Dropdown selections now adapt to your active profile’s theme.  
[*] Aligned colors for [b]Set Zoom[/b] and [b]Reset Zoom[/b] [b]keybind actions[/b].  
[*] Modernized sliders and settings inputs for a cleaner look.  
[*] Fixed zoom sliders showing excessive decimal places.  
[*] Improved tray icon quality for a sharper look.  
[*] Fixed a bug where "unknown key" would appear in the keybinds

Thank you for all the great suggestions we’ve received in our Discord — they help us shape Scope X into something better every update.  
If you’re new here, we’d love for you to join our Discord and share your ideas too!  

[url=https://discord.gg/customcrosshair]Join our Discord here[/url]

🦆

notes.title: Zoom Profiles: Custom Setups for different games
notes.notes:
[h2]🌟 Profiles Have Arrived![/h2]

The wait is over — [b]Profiles[/b] are now in Scope X!  
You can now assign your [b]Zoom Settings[/b], [b]Keybinds[/b], and [b]Accessibility Settings[/b] to specific profiles, and even associate them with a process for quick swapping.

[b]What's New:[/b]  
[*] Create and save multiple profiles with your own settings  
[*] Associate profiles with specific processes for quick activation  
[*] [b]Auto Profile Detection[/b] toggle — Scope X can switch profiles automatically when you’re in a mapped process  
[*] New theming across the Customize page to clearly show your active profile

notes.title: Patch Notes (2025/07/30)
notes.notes:
[h2]🪴 Patch Notes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added [b]ESC[/b] as an emergency keybind — hold for 3 seconds to remove the Scope X overlay  
[*] Fixed an issue where [b]Global Toggle[/b] was not working as expected  
[*] Fixed an issue where [b]Quit Scope X[/b] didn’t fully close the app — ALT+F4 now stops the process too  
[*] Fixed issues with [b]Zoom Setting Sliders[/b] not behaving properly  
[*] Fixed an issue where [b]ESC keypresses[/b] weren't triggering keybinds  
[*] Fixed an issue where [b]Right Mouse Button[/b] wasn’t recorded in keybind inputs  
[*] Added a small animation when right-clicking to clear a keybind in the table  
[*] Fixed an issue where [b]Controller Support[/b] wasn’t initializing correctly  
[*] Updated UI component for the [b]Color Mode[/b] and [b]Language Selector[/b] dropdown  
[*] Added a [b]System Tray Notification[/b] when Scope X launches in the background  
[*] Added UI elements and detection support for [b]PS5 Controllers[/b]  
[*] Keybind popup and table now reflect the correct controller type ([b]Xbox[/b] or [b]PS5[/b]) based on what you're using
[/list]

Thank you again for all your support!
If you run into any issues or have suggestions for improving Scope X, don’t hesitate to drop by our Discord — we’re active there and always listening to community feedback.

notes.title: New Keybinds Experience, Focus Shapes, and More!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,


Thank you all for the amazing support recently — it’s been incredibly encouraging and has helped us a ton as we continue growing Scope X. This update brings new customization options, better UI flow, and a bunch of quality-of-life improvements. 


Here’s what’s new:



[h3]⌨️ New Keybinds Experience[/h3]
[b]What's New:[/b]
[list]
[*] All keybinds are now managed in a single, easy-to-use table — add as many as you need for any action.
[*] Added custom zoom amounts for [b]Increase / Decrease Zoom[/b].
[*] Added [b]Delay (ms)[/b] setting for [b]Toggle Zoom (Hold)[/b].
[*] New [b]Set Zoom[/b] action to jump to a specific zoom level.
[/list]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555467/73cb085bdac9e0494fb1aadb695d7989a6be5d66.png"][/img]



[h3] 📐Focus Shape + Outline[/h3]
[b]What's New:[/b]
[list]
[*] New [b]Focus Shape Settings[/b] UI for easier customization.
[*] Added [b]Focus Shape Variants[/b]:
  [list]
  [*] Circle
  [*] Square
  [*] Rectangle
  [*] Custom — define your own width, height, and roundness
  [/list]
[*] Easy toggle for Focus Shape Background.
[*] Focus Shape [b]Outline[/b] has also been added.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555467/49bd858ff0410b3ed891a7adda8c8d5ae309ad89.png[/img]



[h3]🪴Quality of Life Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved the Position Picker experience and fixed preview not loading.
[*] Added more UI animations for smoother transitions.
[*] Fixed UI stutter when changing shortcut keys or languages.
[*] Sidebar and title bar now update properly when switching languages.
[*] Added [b]Zoom Behavior[/b] dropdown: [i]Fixed Position[/i], [i]Follow Cursor[/i].
[*] Consolidated Focus Shape, Zoom Settings, and Follow Cursor into a single [b]Zoom Settings[/b] tab.
[*] Reduced sidebar width to maximize space in smaller window sizes.
[/list]

We think this updated UI will lay a great foundation for the future.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45555467/2a1f2e380dbf99d351a242a528304c672f59c604.png"][/img][/p][h1]Ring position![/h1][p]Many of you have asked for the ability to change the position of the Ring position (great for games like Hunt) and we've made that possible. notes.title: Scope X & Rust
notes.notes:
[h3][b]What does this mean?[/b][/h3][p]In short, you won't be able to use Scope X in Rust.[/p][p][/p][p]We want to clarify that, to our knowledge, no one has been banned, and we do not anticipate any bans resulting from this change.[/p][p][/p][p]This is strictly a block of our application in specifically Rust, and NOT in any other games.
